source_decisions: Music font, line widths and glyph stem offsets are measured from this PDF, not copied from another song.
System starts and 79 source measures are read from the printed system numbers. The system beginning at m29 has two measures and is indented.
E4E3 is the whole-measure rest at m30-33; no duration is inferred from horizontal width.
No dotted notes, tuplets, grace notes, ties, sloped beams or down-stem voices occur in the identified source. Unsupported MScore glyphs are reported.
Open/close action glyphs retain their source event and coordinates, including close markers at beats with no hi-hat head. No additional hi-hat attack is invented.
